core_3_required.title: N=1 statistical power floor
core_3_required.detail: Subject = user mk55992@proton.me only. No between-subject denominator. Phase-internal cross-validation only. Min detectable r at alpha=0.01 power=0.8 with N=300 per phase ~ 0.16. N=1 = no generalizability claim.

core_3_required.title: Single 30-min session generalizability ceiling
core_3_required.detail: Diurnal/circadian/fatigue all confounded with phase order. Counter-balancing infeasible at N=1; phase order frozen P1->P6 so session-drift is constant. Replication required for any inference beyond pilot.

core_3_required.title: BSE-1 Pearson primary, BSE-3 TE-KSG diagnostic-only
core_3_required.detail: Pearson is linear-coupling estimator; misses nonlinear coupling. BSE-3 TE-KSG runs as secondary diagnostic but does NOT drive verdict tier. Honest interpretation: PASS_STRONG with low TE = linear-coupling-only signal.

additional_4.title: 3-way subset substituted for 4-way slot in F1_score_v2
additional_4.detail: AKIDA Mind substrate not arrived; 3-way (CLM x EEG x tension_link) substituted. Honest reporting: 4-way result with AKIDA may shift up OR down vs 3-way. Phase E reports 3-way as conservative estimate with explicit AKIDA-pending caveat.

additional_4.title: P3/P4 cognitive-load matching not validated
additional_4.detail: P3 (CLM-read) vs P4 (mental arithmetic) designed as cognitive-load matched controls but actual effort/working-memory/modality not pre-measured with NASA-TLX. If F-PASS, follow-up NASA-TLX self-report needed. If F-ARTIFACT, cognitive-load mismatch a primary suspect.

additional_4.title: CLM W4 active branch fixed-point near-constant primary channel
additional_4.detail: CLM v4 W4 active branch has fixed-point std ~ 1e-6 by design. Primary mind_tension channel will be near-constant; supplement with gate_random / L1 / phi / psi_eps from 5ch outlet. Pair_C (CLM x tension_link) excluded from binding aggregation if pair_C |r|>0.95 AND CLM std<1e-5 (trivial fixed-point).

additional_4.title: F2 unfire compound condition not within Phase E scope
additional_4.detail: Even if F-PASS_STRONG (binding>0.5, F1_score_v2 > 0.5), CP2-CLM verdict stays RED-with-strong-binding-evidence until Suite 6 14-gate F2 fires unfire. F2 unfire requires path (b) learned phi_extractor or path (c) substrate redesign — outside Phase E scope. YELLOW band only reachable post-F2-unfire.
